breakpoints.note: The staged HDF5 witness is admitted as a file because root-group opening succeeds here, so `H5Fopen` returns a valid file ID and the later dataset-open path reaches symbol-table lookup.
First non-harness project statement on the witnessed path that consumes attacker-controlled local-heap header bytes and decodes the datablock extent into `heap->dblk_size`.

The fixing hunk adds `bt_udata.common.block_size = H5HL_heap_get_size(heap)` in `src/H5Gstab.c` and changes `H5G__node_cmp3` from `HDstrcmp` to `strncmp(udata->name, s, (udata->block_size - lt_key->offset))` on this left-side compare. Related patch hunks similarly replace other symbol-table `strcmp`/`strlen`/`strdup` uses with heap-size-bounded variants, which is the missing obligation on the witnessed path.
